name: stoop
description: Sell anything without meeting anyone. Money moves only when your doorbell sees it go.

scripts.demo: pnpm cards && concurrently -k -n stack,alexa,pass,ops -c yellow,cyan,green,magenta "pnpm stack" "pnpm --filter @stoop/alexa-sim dev" "pnpm --filter @stoop/pass dev" "pnpm --filter @stoop/ops dev"
scripts.build:web: pnpm cards && pnpm --filter @stoop/alexa-sim exec vite build --base=/app/alexa-sim/ && pnpm --filter @stoop/pass exec vite build --base=/app/pass/ && pnpm --filter @stoop/ops exec vite build --base=/app/ops/
